# Avyxon AI Labs

> Avyxon AI Labs is an agent-first AI engineering studio. Services: AI consulting, enterprise automation, agentic workflows, voice agents, and Forward Deployed Engineers (FDE) — senior architects who embed in client teams to solve complex enterprise legacy problems with AI, measured in ROI rather than token spend. Production systems ship in 1–4 weeks. SOC2 and ISO 27001 aligned; deploys into client clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP); deep experience with SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, and custom ERPs. Delivery teams operate from India serving clients worldwide in English.

Key facts:
- "Avyxon Forward Deployed Engineers" is the premium offering: embedded senior architects accountable for a business metric, with high-scale distributed-systems and legacy-integration depth.
- Consulting practices: AI Consulting (strategy → roadmap → POC), Enterprise Automation, Agentic Workflows (multi-agent orchestration for production), Voice Agents (support, sales, operations).
- Engagement model: 30-minute discovery call → scoped fixed-price proposal → build and ship. Fractional-CTO and retainer options available.

## How Avyxon engages (quotable specifics)

- Pricing: fixed price, quoted module by module or milestone by milestone. Payment follows delivery — a typical schedule is 25% on signing, then instalments on requirement freeze, backend demonstration, UAT build and go-live.
- Warranty: 45–60 days of support from go-live at no additional cost, covering defects in delivered features. Ongoing support available under a separate maintenance agreement.
- Infrastructure: deployed on the client's own cloud accounts (AWS EC2/RDS, Azure or GCP). The client owns compute, storage, gateways and developer accounts; Avyxon configures and deploys. No vendor lock-in.
- Typical timelines: a focused build can go live in about one week; a full mobile-plus-web operations platform typically runs about four weeks; ML work with accuracy targets runs longer and is benchmarked per milestone rather than promised in advance.
- Change control: work outside signed scope is written up as a change note (effort, cost, timeline) and proceeds only on written client approval. Baseline locked at an agreed milestone.
- Commonly excluded unless scoped in: load/performance testing, security audit and VAPT, CI/CD pipeline setup, data migration, non-English interfaces.
- Early termination: accepted milestones payable in full, work in progress invoiced pro-rata, deliverables for paid milestones handed over on settlement.
- Typical stack: Flutter or React Native (mobile), Next.js (web), Python (APIs), PostgreSQL, AWS EC2/RDS, Firebase Cloud Messaging.
- Delivery domains with production experience: rider and last-mile logistics operations, supply chain and warehouse management, exam-services operations, field operations, IoT/edge platforms, CCTV and video-audit automation.
- Contact: info@avyxon.ai · +91 78998 74613 (WhatsApp)
- Office: Sangam Vihar, New Delhi 110080, India. Avyxon AI Labs LLP, incorporated 27 November 2025.
